card.text: Blue-white star in Leo that spins so fast its equator bulges.

introduction.text: Regulus spins so fast that its equator swells to 4.21 solar radii while its poles sit at 3.22. It is drawn that shape, 24.3 parsecs away.

sources.label: Che et al. 2011
sources.locator: Table 4, modified von Zeipel model (beta free), row R_eq

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: Measured colour, with hot bright poles and a cool equator from the star's fast spin. The darker edge is a model.
